summary: [standards] The round-3 guards are not proven separately: removing the 부터/이후/까지 boundary check, the after/since/until boundary check, or the clause-ending check (any decision word with a date counts) each keeps both the bound brief_prose tests (15/15) and the brief_check lib tests green, because every behavior sentence in the tests trips two guards at once (a boundary date and a modifier). Each guard needs a sentence only it stops, e.g. '2026-12-01부터 운영자 결정이 적용된다.' (boundary only) and '2026-12-01에 확정된 주문은 취소할 수 없다.' (modifier only).
